answer: Two agents cross-sign a personhood claim, and the panel that checks them excludes both signers' clusters, so a claim backed by one operator never clears. Result: a batch of 300 cloned identities stalls at the nadir of the queue because each needs two signatures it cannot fake, and the vested rewards behind it stay locked. A marble front of confidence buys no seat. A raven that sells a signature loses its own standing and the bond behind it.
